name: Dr. Madaraka Ogoye
title: Co-Founder & Lead Surgeon
bio: Dr. Madaraka Ogoye is a consultant surgeon with extensive experience in minimally invasive surgery. A co-founder of AfyaHub, he is passionate about making world-class surgical care accessible to Kenyan families. He trained locally and internationally, bringing cutting-edge laparoscopic techniques to Nairobi.
qualifications: Fellow, College of Surgeons of East Africa

name: Dr. Misheck Wanjiku
title: Co-Founder & Clinical Director
bio: Dr. Misheck Wanjiku is a physician and endoscopist who co-founded AfyaHub with a vision of patient-centred, consultant-led care. Her expertise in gastrointestinal medicine and endoscopy ensures patients receive comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic care under one roof.

name: Dr. Samuel Kariuki
title: Consultant Anaesthesiologist
bio: Dr. Samuel Kariuki provides safe, patient-focused anaesthetic care for all surgical and endoscopic procedures at AfyaHub. His meticulous approach to perioperative management ensures every patient is in the best possible hands throughout their procedure.
